name: MD17
description: A molecular dynamics benchmark containing atomistic trajectories for eight small organic molecules, with energies and forces calculated using density functional theory. This metadata record does not distribute dataset data.
citation: Chmiela, S., Tkatchenko, A., Sauceda, H. E., Poltavsky, I., Schütt, K. T., & Müller, K.-R. (2017). Machine learning of accurate energy-conserving molecular force fields. Science Advances, 3(5), e1603015. https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.1603015
